proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4822 connects Hindi cimṭā/cyũṭā ‘pincers’ with the *cimb pinch family; Platts s.v. cimṭī explicitly includes ant and cross-refers to cīṅṭī/cyūṅṭī, whose entries give the small-ant formations. This supports a qualified semantic family, not a uniquely established remote reconstruction; nasal loss, Bagheli internal h and extended endings still need local review.
